verdict.rationale: The story asks whether operating-hours windows, per-day limits, or session timeouts on the online flow are published before the founder starts, which is a fair question for a government online-filing service. None of the evidence items mention service hours, maintenance windows, daily limits, or session timeouts for BRO, EFILE, or the CRA account. With no evidence of the capability, the verdict is none.
